blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model's developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. Eleven of these fourteen gains survive a Holm correction (slang with eighteen candidates and descriptive sentences with five do not), and for jargon on all labels the label-level interval excludes zero in both settings. On abbreviations and opaque codes it gives no usable gain: on abbreviations it is not better, and worse on the clean slice, and on opaque codes both releases stay at or below chance once labels related to training options are removed. In most cells where accuracy rises, the risk-coverage area falls, but with eighteen candidates confident errors rise on jargon and slang. On two datasets neither release saw, accuracy moves by -8.4 and +5.6 points. We also report four evaluation hazards from comparing the two releases.
blocks.zh: 型号决定模型对调用者在请求时间提供的选项进行评分,因此其准确性取决于该模型的开发者不控制的标签措辞. 我们比较了两个版本,一个307M参数的多语言交叉编码器Ru-Jev,经过了13个俄语任务的培训;后来的版本增加了一个增量,呈现了几种表面形式的标签. 我们持有的问题只有固定和不同的18个路由标签,我们评价10个路由词汇,由三个不同的程序制作,并核对与培训数据的重叠,每个问题有5名候选人,其中8名还有18名候选人。 在用普通或借词(英语衍生的词汇、办公室名、部门名)制作的搁置词汇表上,增加的发布在每个场合都更准确,最多0.24. 在这14项收益中,有11项在Holm更正后幸存下来(有18个候选者,有5个没有的描述性句子),对于所有标签上的术语,标签级别间隔排除了两种设置中的0。 在缩略语和不透明代码上,它不会产生有用的收益:在缩略语上,它并不更好,在干净的片子上更糟糕;在不透明代码上,一旦与培训选项有关的标签被删除,那么释放就会处于或低于机会。 在精度上升的大多数细胞中,风险覆盖面积下降,但随着18名候选人的自信错误在词汇和词典上上升. 在两个数据集上,没有看到释放,准确度移动至-8.4和+5.6点。 我们还报告通过比较这两个释放物对四种评估危害。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text classifiers have historically fixed their label set at training time. A
growing class of interfaces does not: the caller supplies the candidate options
at request time, in the caller’s own words. This covers zero-shot
classification by entailment ( Yin et al., 2019 ) , prompt-based classification with
verbalizers ( Schick and Schütze, 2021 ) , structured output from instruction-following
models, and compact typed-decision models that return a decision of a
declared type with a probability and generate no free text ( Deußer et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Convai Innovations, 2026 ) .

文字分类器历史上在训练时间固定了自己的标签设置. A级
正在增长的接口类别不会: 呼叫者提供候选选项
要求时,用打电话者自己的话说。 这个覆盖了零发
(Yin等人,2019年),与
发音器(Schick and Schütze, 2021 ),指令后的结构化输出

有概率并生成无自由文本的已声明类型(Deußer等,2026;Wang等,2026;Convai Innovations,2026)。

blocks.en:
When the label set arrives at request time, accuracy becomes a function of the
strings the caller chose. Benchmarks usually score models on the label names
the dataset authors wrote, while deployments often use names the organisation
already has: department names, internal codes, abbreviations and borrowings
from English. That label wording affects behaviour is established. Webson and Pavlick (2022) find prompt-based models far more sensitive to the choice of
target words than to the instruction; Gao et al. (2021) search over label words
because the choice matters; Holtzman et al. (2021) identify surface form
competition in multiple-choice scoring; Gao et al. (2023) show that
training on label descriptions improves robustness to verbalizer choice. In
vision, robustness gained from one family of corruptions often fails to
transfer to others ( Geirhos et al., 2018 ) .

blocks.en:
We ask a practical question. If training presents each label in several
surface forms, which kinds of unfamiliar label wording does the model then
handle better? We answer it with probes that hold the questions fixed and vary
only the wording, at two candidate-set sizes, with every probe label checked
against the training data.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: 1. A controlled measurement over ten label vocabularies, two
candidate-set sizes and three probe sources, with exact paired tests,
label-level resampling and a multiple-comparison correction
(Sections 5 and 6 ). 2. The finding that label-wording augmentation improves accuracy on
held-out vocabularies of ordinary and borrowed words, but not on abbreviations
or opaque codes, and that a probe at a single candidate-set size can misstate
the effect (Section 6 ). 3. Out-of-distribution and cross-model results against an open model on the
same backbone (Section 7 ). 4. Four hazards in release-to-release comparison, each with its measured
effect on numbers we had prepared for publication (Section 9 ).

blocks.zh: 2 类型决定

blocks.en:
A typed decision is a triple ( c , O , t ) (c,O,t) : a context c c , a set of candidate
options O = { o 1 , … , o k } O=\{o_{1},\dots,o_{k}\} , and a declared type t ∈ t\in {boolean,
choice, scale}. The model returns a distribution over O O .

blocks.en:
Two properties follow. The output does not depend on the order of the options,
since no option sees another. And because each option’s score is computed
independently, the distribution over any subset of a candidate set is obtained
exactly by renormalising that subset’s scores; we use this to evaluate the
same probe at five and at eighteen candidates from one scoring pass. The price
is cost linear in k k . Models that read all options in one pass, such as Laya ( Convai Innovations, 2026 ) , trade order invariance for lower cost at large k k (Section 8 ).

blocks.en: 3 Model and data
blocks.zh: 3 模型和数据

blocks.en:
The encoder is mmBERT-base ( Marone et al., 2026 ) , 307M parameters of which
110M are outside the embedding matrix, released under the MIT licence. Inputs
are truncated to 256 tokens. Training uses thirteen tasks built from open
Russian-language datasets: six tasks from RussianSuperGLUE ( Shavrina et al., 2020 ) ,
RuCoLA ( Mikhailov et al., 2022 ) , one reasoning task pooling the ruOpenBookQA and
ruWorldTree sets of MERA ( Fenogenova et al., 2024 ) , four classification tasks from
ruMTEB ( Snegirev et al., 2025 ) (review sentiment, review rating, and the
intent and scenario tasks of MASSIVE ( FitzGerald et al., 2023 ) ), and a toxicity
set ( Dementieva et al., 2021 ) . The mix contains 143,991 training and 26,746
validation decisions. Each source keeps its own licence; the repository lists
them per source, including one whose README asks for research use while its
licence file is an unmodified MIT licence.

blocks.en:
Training runs four epochs with a checkpoint after each, and the third is
released (stored zero-indexed as epoch 2). The fourth overfits: training loss
falls to 0.085 while validation loss rises to 0.820 (Table 1 ),
and a temperature fitted on its outputs reaches 3.92, against 1.864 for the
released third epoch. Epoch selection and
temperature fitting both used the validation split, which includes the MASSIVE
validation rows; the datasets of Section 7 played no role in
model selection.

blocks.en: 4 The two releases
blocks.zh: 页:1 两个版本

blocks.en:
Release v1.1 presents each MASSIVE scenario label as its English key and as an
ordinary Russian word; in the rebuilt v1.1 training mix both forms occur for
all 18 scenarios, and Russian-phrase strings occur for two. Release v1.3 stores
several surface forms per label and draws one uniformly per training example.
As specified in the data builder: • MASSIVE intents (60 labels): the English key, an ordinary Russian label,
the key transliterated into Cyrillic, and a clipped form of that
transliteration produced by rule; • MASSIVE scenarios (18 labels): the English key, an ordinary Russian
word, and a Russian phrase; • toxicity: five wordings of the two labels, of which v1.1 used one; • review sentiment: five wordings of the label set, and review rating:
four, where v1.1 used one each. Transliterated and clipped forms are never applied to scenario labels.

blocks.zh: 5 评价设计

blocks.en:
All wording probes use the same 1,000 questions from
the source validation split of the MASSIVE scenario task (7 are duplicates).
Neither release trained on these rows, but both used them for epoch selection
and temperature fitting. Each question has one gold scenario among 18.

blocks.en:
Every probe label was compared with every
option string in the rebuilt training mixes of both releases, by exact equality
and by prefix in both directions, for gold labels and distractors. Two card-bench
vocabularies are training styles: the English key and the Russian word occur in
both releases’ training data for all 18 labels, so they serve as controls, not
probes. The Russian phrase occurs in v1.3’s training data for all 18 labels and
in v1.1’s for two (one of which is identical to the Russian word), so its gain is expected by construction. The
department-name and descriptive vocabularies have no exact match in either
release, but all descriptive labels and two department labels have a prefix
relation to some training option, so neither has a strict slice; the jargon
vocabulary has three exact matches in v1.3’s training data
(audio, news, weather), which its clean slice removes. Slices: for jargon, clean drops the three labels that coincide
with the output of the transliteration rule (audio, news, weather; 15 labels,
882 questions) and strict drops every label with an exact or prefix
relation to a training option (11 labels, 625 questions). For the independent
probe, strict drops labels with an exact or prefix relation (slang 14 labels,
codes 9);
for abbreviations, clean drops the one exact match. Filtering applies to the
gold label; distractors are not filtered.

On every held-out vocabulary made of

In most cells where accuracy improves, the risk–coverage
area falls, so a caller who thresholds on confidence is better served (among
non-control cells, the only exception is slang on all labels with eighteen candidates, 0.354 to 0.395): on strict jargon
AURC goes from 0.235 to 0.078 with five candidates and from 0.452 to 0.418 with
eighteen; on strict slang from 0.223 to 0.121 with five candidates and is
unchanged (0.476 against 0.470) with eighteen. The count of confident errors
tells a less favourable story. With five candidates it falls on jargon (110 to
62 per 1,000 on the strict slice). With eighteen it rises on jargon (79 to
109 on all labels) and on slang (151 to 191 on the strict slice), consistent with the
augmented release being more confident overall, while it falls on department
names (123 to 87). On abbreviations it rises (77 to
118 on the clean slice). The augmentation therefore does not, by itself, make
confidence safer on unfamiliar wording; a deployment should refit the
temperature on its own labels.

blocks.en:
The release trained on several surface forms per label is
more accurate on unfamiliar labels that are words, ordinary or borrowed, including
words of kinds it never saw in training (slang, department names). It gives no usable
gain on abbreviations or opaque codes, where the label string carries little
of its meaning. Because the releases differ in more than the augmentation
(Section 4 ) and each was trained once, these are differences
between two trained models, consistent with the augmentation as their cause
but not a controlled ablation of it.

blocks.en: 7 Unseen datasets and an open comparison model
blocks.zh: 第7条 不明数据集和开放式比较模型

blocks.en:
Two Russian datasets were used by neither release and are not named in Laya’s
model card, which does not list its training data: news headline topics from ruMTEB (six classes; licence declared
as MIT in the repository metadata, no licence file) and single-label rows of
CEDR emotions ( Sboev et al., 2021 ) (five classes; Apache-2.0 in the metadata).
Laya ( Convai Innovations, 2026 ) is a 322M model on the same mmBERT backbone that reads all
options in one pass. It was given a one-line instruction, which its interface
requires and Ru-Jev does not take; option keys were neutral, so the option text
carried the meaning for both.

No model is more accurate on both datasets (Table 3 ). v1.3 is

blocks.en: 9 Four hazards in comparing releases
blocks.zh: 第9条 比较释放的四种危险

blocks.en:
Our first comparison of the releases reported a clean accuracy gain and two
large regressions. None of the three was real. We list the hazards because none
is exotic and each was invisible in the output of a comparison that did not
test for it.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
The data builder
carved each task’s validation slice with the module-level random generator,
seeded once and consumed by every other random call in the file. Adding label
styles to one task changed the number of draws consumed before the next task
was carved, and every later task received a different partition. Intersecting
the two builds shows the result is leakage: 90.3% of the new acceptability
validation rows and 89.4% of the reasoning rows had been in the v1.1 training
data, along with 47.2% of review rating and 21.6% of toxicity. The apparent
regression on acceptability (0.909 to 0.647) was v1.1 scored on its own
training rows; on held-out rows it scores 0.650. The fix seeds each carve from
the task’s identity, random.Random(f"split:{task}") . We verified it by
rebuilding the previous release’s data from its commit and confirming that the
validation rows of the six tasks whose option sets never changed were identical
to the earlier build.
blocks.zh:
数据构建器
用模块级随机生成器刻出每个任务的验证片,
播种过一次 被文件里的每一个随机呼叫所消耗 添加标签
样式改为一个任务, 将下一个任务前的绘图数 。

两座建筑显示渗出:90.3%的新可接受性
验证行和89.4%的推理行参加了v1.1培训
数据,以及47.2%的审查评级和21.6%的毒性。 很明显
关于可接受性的回归(0.909至0.647)是 v1.1 自己得分
训练行;在被搁置的行中,得分为0.650分. 每个雕刻的固定种子
任务的身份,随机。 随机(f"split:{ task}"). 我们核实过
重新整理前一次释放的数据并证实
选项集从未更改的六个任务的验证行是相同的
到早期的建筑。

blocks.en:
Matching validation rows by
input text gave nine comparable tasks. Under the augmented recipe a row with
the same text can carry an option wording the baseline never saw, so scoring
the baseline there measures robustness, not accuracy. Requiring identical text and option wording leaves six tasks. A toxicity gain of 0.722 to 0.954
that we had presented as a capability gain was of this kind: v1.3 trained on
all five toxicity wordings, v1.1 on one, and v1.1 scores 0.961 with the wording
it trained on.
blocks.zh:
匹配验证行

同样的文字可以带有基准从未见过的选项措辞,因此得分
基线衡量的是稳健性,而不是准确性。 需要相同的文本和备选案文措辞,留下了六项任务。 毒性增益为0.722至0.954
我们作为能力增益提出的是此类:v1.3
所有5个毒性措辞,其中一为v1.1,一为v1.1的分数为0.961。
它训练。

blocks.en:
A summary row computed on one random half of
the comparable rows (0.7948 against 0.7920 on 5,078 decisions) was printed
beside a per-task table counting all 10,157, and a calibration advantage
(0.0172 against 0.0160) was read off that one split. On all rows accuracy is
identical, and the calibration difference changes sign across splits. Both
figures had reached the published model card and were withdrawn. A related
slip appeared in our drafts: a worst-case gap computed as the best vocabulary
on all labels minus the jargon vocabulary on the clean slice.

随机计算一个摘要行

(0.0172对0.0160)从这一分期付款中删去。 所有行的准确性

blocks.en:
To estimate seed
variance we retrained both recipes on a remote machine and checked its training
mix against a local copy by SHA-256, row count and per-task counts. All
matched. The local copy predated the commit that added the transliteration
styles, so the seed runs meant to replicate v1.3 were trained without them;
their jargon accuracy (0.588 and 0.611) fell near v1.1’s. Row counts could not
catch this, since the new styles change option strings, not the number of rows.
Counting distinct option strings per task did (120 for intents in the stale
copy, 198 after rebuilding; some generated forms coincide). These runs were
never published and are excluded from every result here.

估计种子

相匹配的。 本地副本在承诺之前添加了转写

它们的词汇精度(0.588和0.611)接近v1.1. 无法计算行数
选中此项, 因为新样式会改变选项字符串, 而不是行数 。
每个任务计算不同的选项字符串( 120个在 stale 中的意向)
复制,重建后为198;一些生成的表格重合). 这些跑步是

blocks.en:
Seed every partition from the identity of what is
partitioned; define comparability over everything the model consumes and print
the overlap; measure leakage directly; choose a control that a change must not
move; keep one denominator per table; verify artefacts by content that the
change is expected to alter, not by hashes against a copy of unknown age; and
evaluate wording robustness at more than one candidate-set size.
blocks.zh:
将每个分区从什么的身份中播下
分区; 定义模型所消耗和打印的一切的可比性
重叠; 直接测量渗漏; 选择一个不可更改的控制
移动; 每个表格保留一个分母; 按内容验证手工艺品
变化预期会改变,而不是对年龄不明的复制品匆匆进行;
以一个以上候选人人数评价措辞是否有力。

blocks.en: 10 Limitations
blocks.zh: 10 限制

blocks.en:
One training run per release. The released v1.3 has no valid second
seed. Two correctly built replicates of the v1.1 recipe scored 0.658 and 0.622
on jargon with five candidates (0.645 and 0.599 on the clean slice), against
0.633 (0.624) for the released v1.1, so the released baseline lies inside its
own seed range. That range, 0.036 on all labels and 0.046 on the clean slice,
is roughly four to six times smaller than the jargon gains of v1.3 ( + 0.222 +0.222 and + 0.214 +0.214 ), but comparable to several smaller differences in
Table 2 , which should not be treated as reproducible.
Seed variance was measured only for the v1.1 recipe, on jargon, with five
candidates; we have no seed estimate for eighteen candidates or for the slang
and code probes.

与5名候选人(0.645和0.599在干净的片子上)相对

blocks.en:
Not a single-factor comparison. The releases differ in data partitions
and in toxicity wording as well as in label augmentation
(Section 4 ). The out-of-distribution changes in particular cannot
be attributed to the augmentation alone.

不是单因子比较. 数据分区的发布不同
毒性措辞和标签增加值
(第4节) 分配外的变化尤其不能
仅仅因为增加。

blocks.en:
Vocabularies. Each style is one vocabulary of 18 labels, so style and
vocabulary are confounded, and label-level intervals rest on 9 to 18 clusters.
All vocabularies were written by the author’s project or by AI agents working
in it; none was collected from deployed systems. Abbreviations and code
identifiers were scored with five candidates only.
blocks.zh:

词汇令人困惑,而标签级别间隔则在9到18个集群上.
所有词汇都由作者的项目或人工智能代理撰写
没有从已部署的系统中收集到任何资料。 简称和代码
鉴定结果只有5名候选人。

blocks.en:
Scope. Wording probes cover one routing task in Russian. The model
answers only within the options it is given and cannot report that none fits;
a none-of-these option must be supplied explicitly. One temperature serves all
tasks and does not carry over to new labels or domains. Reasoning tasks with
fewer than a thousand training rows remain weak; a 560M backbone
(xlm-roberta-large) tried once did not improve them.
blocks.zh:
范围。 文字探测器负责一个俄语的路由任务. 模型
只有在给出的选项中才能回答,而且不能报告不符合;
任何一种选择都必须明确提供。 一个温度服务大家
任务,而不会结转到新的标签或域。 任务说明
不到1 000个训练排仍然薄弱;560M骨干
(xlm-roberta-group) 一次尝试并没有改善它们.

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en:
When the caller supplies the label set, an evaluation that varies the model but
not the label wording measures the easy case. Varying the wording at two
candidate-set sizes showed that the release trained on several surface forms per label
is more accurate on unfamiliar labels that are words, ordinary or borrowed, and
gives no usable gain on abbreviations or opaque codes; and that better accuracy on unfamiliar
wording does not by itself bring fewer confident errors when the candidate set
is large. A practical reading is
to choose augmentation styles that resemble the wording a deployment will use,
to refit the temperature on that wording, and to evaluate on styles absent from
the augmentation at more than one candidate-set size. We also recommend the
release comparison protocol of Section 9 .
blocks.zh:
当调用者提供标签集时, 评估会改变模型, 但是
而不是标签措辞衡量容易的情况。 两种措辞不同
候选设置大小显示,每个标签的多个表面表单上所训练的释放
在不熟悉的标签上更为准确,这些标签是普通的或借用的;以及
对缩略语或不透明的代码没有有用的好处;
在候选人确定时,措辞本身不会减少自信错误
相当大。 一个实用的阅读是
选择类似部署将使用的措辞的增强样式,
校正该措辞的温度,并评估未使用的样式
以一个以上候选人设定的大小增加。 我们还建议:
第9节的发布比较协议
